title: Recent Job Changer List
one_line: Build a list of people who started a new role in the last few months at target accounts, or who left a customer for a new company, and give each one a reason to reach out now.
description: Build a list of people who started a new role in the last few months at target accounts, or who left a customer for a new company, and give each one a reason to reach out now. Use when someone wants new hire outreach, champion tracking, or a list of buyers in their first 90 days.
paragraph: A person in the first months of a new role is reviewing tools, budgets and vendors, and a champion who moved companies brings a warm relationship to a new account. This skill finds both groups, dates each move from a source, and drops the moves it cannot date, because an undated move reads as fresh when it may be two years old.
keywords: new hires at my target accounts

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: new-hire-finder 0.085 USD per new hire found; job-change-tracker 0.025 USD per person read and 0.006 USD per profile resolved; people-finder 0.02 USD per company searched, 0.02 USD per person, 0.04 USD per email found and 0.015 USD per email verified.
Free. On a python.org install on macOS, run `Install Certificates.command` once, or the script falls back to the system certificate file and says so if it cannot.

requirements.used_for: The people search inside people-finder, and a wider web search in the other two actors
